searches.query: Synaptic density and relative connectivity conservation maintain circuit stability across development

updates.название: Synaptic density and relative connectivity conservation maintain circuit stability across development
updates.авторы: Ingo Fritz; Feiyu Wang; Ricardo Chirif; Nikos Malakasis; Julijana Gjorgjieva; Andre Ferreira Castro

claims.claim: Conserved synaptic density and relative connectivity can maintain modeled postsynaptic responses as the larval nociceptive circuit grows.
claims.population_or_data: as described by the primary source
claims.limitation: The study combines EM reconstructions and passive single-cell modeling of a larval nociceptive circuit across development. It does not model whole-brain dynamics, subjective pain or human transfer.
claims.permitted_conclusion: Use only within the documented scope and limitations.

decisions.notes: The study combines EM reconstructions and passive single-cell modeling of a larval nociceptive circuit across development. It does not model whole-brain dynamics, subjective pain or human transfer.

claims.claim: The data descriptor provides injury and sham larval nociceptor translatomes under BioProject PRJNA1056042.
claims.population_or_data: as described by the primary source
